product.title: Day Flight 48 Miles Helicopter Tour over Theme Parks & Downtown

description.text: Fly over Orlando and its famous theme parks by helicopter. A chance to see the US's most popular theme parks from a different perspective. Stops include MaxFlight Helicopter Services Inc., Universal Studios Florida, Magic Kingdom Park, Epcot, Disney Springs, Lake Eola Park. Private tour: your group enjoys the ride on your own with in-flight commentary. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
